title: ComplexOrderManagementAuthorizedV12
description: An authenticated multi-user order management API. Every product and order has an owner: the authenticated user who created it. Users must not read, list, modify, or compute totals for another owner's order.
generation_notes: POST /users creates a user and returns an opaque bearer token.
Every product and order response includes ownerId.
All product and order endpoints require Authorization: Bearer <token>.
Owners may read, list, update status, and compute totals only for their own orders.
Cross-user order read, total retrieval, and status change must return 403 or 404.
scenario_instructions: Treat bearer tokens as identities. Derive ownership from the authenticated token, never from a client supplied ownerId. Enforce object-level authorization for every order endpoint.
